name: [Katagami] Production telemetry has gone quiet
message:
No server event has arrived from production in four hours. Katagami is not that quiet — this almost certainly means the telemetry is broken, not that nobody used the site.

Every other Katagami monitor filters env:production. While this condition holds, none of them can fire, so silence from them means nothing.

Causes in order of likelihood:
  VERCEL_REGION is no longer set at runtime, so telemetryEnv tags everything local-verify (check for events under env:local-verify — if they are there, this is it)
  DD_API_KEY was removed or rotated in Vercel, so emitServerEvent fails closed
  the site is down

Logs: https://app.datadoghq.com/logs?query=service%3Akatagami-server
